extensionDescription.message: Zoom, rotate, and drag images or background graphics with right-click and mouse wheel gestures without breaking page layouts.

lblAltRightWheel.message: Alt key + Right click + Mouse wheel rotate

lblCtrlRightWheel.message: Ctrl key + Right click + Mouse wheel rotate

optZoomStep.message: Zoom ratio of one mouse wheel

optRotationStep.message: Rotation angle of one mouse wheel

optAutoResetRelease.message: Revert images when to release the right click

lblLeftClickDrag.message: Left click to drag (on zoomed images)

lblAltRightLeftClick.message: Alt Key + Right click + Left click

optDraggableSingleImage.message: Draggable when zoomed in image view page

optRightClickTimeout.message: Time until right click is canceled

hlpRightClickTimeout.message: After right click, if this time passes without rotating the wheel, right click is released after this time. (1000ms = 1 second)

lblExcludedDomains.message: Disable on these domains (one per line):

hlpExcludedDomains.message: e.g. maps.google.com or figma.com (subdomains are automatically included)

optEnableKeyShortcuts.message: Enable keyboard shortcuts (+/−, arrow keys, Esc, 0, R/L)
